items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: I had a five-piece band. But when that engagement broke up they all left except myself and Ted Prysock.

ctx.x: Oh, when we first went there, yeah, --

I had a five-piece band. But when that engagement broke up they all left except myself and Ted Prysock. And we just hung in town, and first thing you know we got this job for a couple of weeks. That's why I say we sent for Jerry Potter. He lives right up the block from me. Very good drummer, man, excellent. And he came out and then we got a piano player and a bass out there and at that time I had made some records for Atlantic. See it helped start Atlantic Records off, in a room no larger than this -- little…
How did you get to make the records? Did they see you perform.
